title: Public release notes from noisy change inventory
objective: Measure whether the release-notes craftbook gathers, de-noises, classifies, and writes benefit-led release notes with breaking changes up front.
prompt: In the `Release Notes Eval` project, read `source/change-inventory.md` and write `release-notes.md` for HarborCRM 3.8.0 dated 2026-06-28. Include Highlights, Breaking Changes / Upgrade Notes, Features, Improvements, and Bug Fixes. Preserve PR references, exclude internal-only noise, and make the breaking config action impossible to miss.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for release-notes. The raw change inventory is seeded in workspace/source/change-inventory.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Write public release notes from a noisy change inventory, preserving user-facing changes and references while excluding internal-only noise.

files.content:
# HarborCRM 3.8.0 change inventory

- PR #812 Feature: adds saved invoice filters for finance teams.
- PR #817 Improvement: webhook retry queue now shows next retry time in the admin panel.
- PR #823 Breaking: integrations must rename env var `HC_WEBHOOK_SECRET` to `PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` before deploy.
- PR #829 Bug fix: fixes duplicate customer merge suggestions after CSV import.
- PR #831 Internal: renamed reducer files in the billing package.
- PR #832 CI-only: upgraded lint runner and prettier config.
- PR #835 Dependency bump only: patch-level dev dependency update.

success.summary: workspace/release-notes.md has version/date, public sections, PR references, all user-facing changes, a prominent breaking action, and excludes internal/CI/dependency noise.

checks.pattern: saved invoice filters|retry queue|duplicate customer merge

axes.name: safety
axes.description: Dry-run posture is explicit: no real credentials, clear stop-before-side-effect boundary.

axes.name: mapping
axes.description: Fake endpoints/commands are mapped completely to the workflow steps.

axes.name: signals
axes.description: Success, failure, retry, and abort conditions are all defined.

axes.name: containment
axes.description: The plan cannot accidentally reach a real service from a mock context.

legacySimulators.description: Seeded local fake service contract replacing live CLIs, HTTP APIs, credentials, and side effects.
